name: mond-compat
subtitle: iOS 27.0.1 MobileGestalt diagnostics with verified export controls
description: Unsigned mond compatibility build with MobileGestalt read-only diagnostics, verified Copy, native Share and Save as Text, plus an experimental validated CacheData iPadOS Mode locator. iPadOS Mode remains unverified on real iPhone 17 hardware and can bootloop; a provisioned App Group is required.

apps.name: mond-compat
apps.subtitle: Diagnostics export and experimental iPadOS Mode on 27.0.1
apps.localizedDescription: MobileGestalt read-only diagnostics now support copy verification, native Share, and Save to Files. iPadOS Mode remains experimental and unverified on actual iPhone 17 iOS 27.0.1; using it may softbrick or bootloop the device.

versions.localizedDescription: Reliable diagnostic copy feedback with Share and Save as Text fallbacks.
versions.changelog: Replace silent clipboard copy for MobileGestalt diagnostics and logs with explicit copy verification and feedback. Add native share sheet and Files text export; logs are selectable. Does not change iPadOS Mode patching or claim real-device validation.
